description: Full collection-config control for Weaviate Cloud, plus schema history, drift diffing, and lint that no other Weaviate tool has.

novel_features.name: Schema snapshot & history
novel_features.description: Save a point-in-time copy of every collection's config to the local store, then browse history over time.

novel_features.name: Schema drift diff
novel_features.description: Diff a collection's live config against a saved snapshot or another collection.

novel_features.name: Collection config lint
novel_features.description: Flag risky collection configs: no vectorizer set, replication factor of 1, unindexed high-cardinality properties.

novel_features.name: Cross-collection tenant audit
novel_features.description: See tenant counts and activity status across every collection in one view.

novel_features.name: Schema export/import bundle
novel_features.description: Export every collection's config as one portable JSON bundle for backup or promotion to another environment.
